articles.title: Luxury BMW Crushed in Seconds at Toll Plaza — Senior High Court Lawyer Killed in Shocking Mishap
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A concrete-laden truck overturned onto a BMW car at Keesara Toll Plaza in Kanchikacharla mandal on the Hyderabad–Vijayawada highway, completely flattening the luxury vehicle and killing a senior lawyer.

body.html:
A concrete-laden truck overturned onto a BMW car at Keesara Toll Plaza in Kanchikacharla mandal on the Hyderabad–Vijayawada highway, completely flattening the luxury vehicle and killing a senior lawyer.

The BMW bearing registration number TS 09 FT 6662 was heading towards Hyderabad when the accident occurred between 4:15 pm and 4:20 pm. A concrete mixer tanker reportedly lost control near the toll plaza and toppled onto the car.

The victim has been identified as B. Srinivas Rao, a prominent High Court advocate. He had earlier participated in the Bar Council elections in Amaravati and was returning at the time of the incident.

According to Vijayawada Police Commissioner SV Raja Sekhara Babu, the body was retrieved with the help of JCBs and sent for post-mortem examination. Authorities are currently examining CCTV footage to ascertain the exact cause of the accident, including the possibility of overloading or driver negligence.

Disturbing visuals from the scene show the tanker lying sideways on top of the red BMW, crushing it completely.

Preliminary reports suggest that the tanker, carrying ready-mix concrete, lost control while taking a turn, possibly due to brake failure. The BMW was crossing the toll gate when the heavy vehicle overturned, flattening it almost instantly.

Police and toll plaza staff launched a rescue operation immediately, deploying cranes and earthmovers to lift the tanker.

The incident also led to partial disruption of traffic on the highway.

articles.title: Outrage in Hafizpur: Youth Lights Hookah from Funeral Pyre, Video Sparks Anger
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video from Mahmudpur village under Hafizpur police station limits has triggered widespread outrage after a young man was seen lighting a hookah using flames from a funeral pyre.

body.html:
A disturbing video from Mahmudpur village under Hafizpur police station limits has triggered widespread outrage after a young man was seen lighting a hookah using flames from a funeral pyre.

The incident took place during the last rites of Munni Devi (75), who was cremated on Friday (10 April 2026) at the village cremation ground.

According to reports, after the funeral rituals were completed and relatives had left, four youths — identified as Abhishek, Vineet, Arif, and Moin — allegedly arrived at the site carrying hookahs.

One of them used the burning pyre to light the hookah while the others recorded the act on video, which was later circulated widely on social media.

The visuals, showing the youth sitting near the pyre and using its flames, have deeply hurt public sentiments, with villagers calling the cremation ground a sacred place and demanding strict action.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Praveen Kumar, station in-charge, confirmed that police have arrested one of the accused, while efforts are underway to trace the remaining suspects.

Police stated that further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

#UttarPradesh #Hafizpur #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #PublicOutrage

articles.title: Drunk Brawl Turns Ugly in Greater Noida West: Youths Create Ruckus, Strip on Road After Clash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A late-night dispute outside Seventh Avenue Market in Gaur City-2 Society in Greater Noida West escalated into a shocking public spectacle, with intoxicated youths creating chaos on the road. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and has since gone viral.

body.html:
A late-night dispute outside Seventh Avenue Market in Gaur City-2 Society in Greater Noida West escalated into a shocking public spectacle, with intoxicated youths creating chaos on the road. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and has since gone viral.

According to police, the altercation broke out between two groups after a vehicle ahead allegedly refused to give way to a black Thar. The youths honked repeatedly, leading to a heated argument that soon turned into a physical scuffle.

Following the clash, some youths stepped out of the Thar, created a ruckus on the road, stripped half-naked, and shouted abuses, causing panic among residents.

Police said the accused were under the influence of alcohol at the time of the incident.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Bisrakh Police acted swiftly and arrested two accused. The Thar vehicle involved in the incident has also been seized.

Further investigation is underway, and police have assured strict action against those involved.

articles.title: Morning Walk Turns Fatal in Mirzapur: Lawyer Shot Dead, Attackers Struggle to Flee in CCTV Twist
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking broad daylight murder in Mirzapur, a senior advocate was shot dead by two bike-borne assailants, with dramatic CCTV footage capturing both the murder and the accused’s failed escape attempt.

body.html:
In a shocking broad daylight murder in Mirzapur, a senior advocate was shot dead by two bike-borne assailants, with dramatic CCTV footage capturing both the murder and the accused’s failed escape attempt.

The deceased has been identified as Rajiv Singh (45), a practising lawyer and former village head.

According to police, the incident occurred around 7:16 am on Saturday when Singh was out on a morning walk. CCTV visuals show two men arriving on a motorcycle, after which one attacker got down and fired at him using a crude pistol, killing him on the spot.

In a dramatic turn, the accuse then attempted to flee but struggled as their motorcycle failed to start. The accomplice was seen repeatedly trying to kick-start the vehicle, causing a brief delay at the crime scene.

As some bystanders cautiously approached, one of the attackers reportedly pointed the pistol at them, forcing them to retreat. After multiple attempts, the motorcycle eventually started, and both assailants managed to escape.

The incident led to panic in the area, with a large crowd gathering at the spot soon after the shooting.

Sources revealed that Singh had earlier expressed fear of a possible attack and had submitted an application regarding threats to his life. He had reportedly been targeted twice in the past as well.

Police have launched an investigation and are analysing CCTV footage to identify and nab the accused.

#Mirzapur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #MurderCase

articles.title: Brutal Night Murder in Dharwad: Youth Congress Leader Hacked to Death Inside Home, Family Witnesses
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The murder of Youth Congress leader Fairoz Khan Pathan has sent shockwaves across Dharwad, with chilling details emerging about the late-night attack inside his residence. The incident took place on the night of April 10 between 9:30 pm and 10:00 pm in the Hashmi Nagar/Mehboob Nagar area.

body.html:
The murder of Youth Congress leader Fairoz Khan Pathan has sent shockwaves across Dharwad, with chilling details emerging about the late-night attack inside his residence.

The incident took place on the night of April 10 between 9:30 pm and 10:00 pm in the Hashmi Nagar/Mehboob Nagar area. According to police, Fairoz was sitting outside his house when an assailant approached him. As he tried to escape inside, four to five masked attackers chased him into the house and brutally assaulted him with sharp weapons in his bedroom.

Fairoz sustained severe head and neck injuries and died on the spot.

Contrary to initial reports, his mother and sister were present at the time of the attack. They reportedly attempted to shield him and suffered minor injuries during the assault.

N Shashikumar confirmed that a murder case has been registered at Dharwad Suburban Police Station. An FIR has been filed against Mohammed Shah and his associates, with the family alleging prior rivalry.

Police said the attackers fled with two mobile phones belonging to the victim. CCTV footage from nearby areas has been recovered and is being analysed as a key lead in the investigation.

Preliminary findings suggest personal or political rivalry as a possible motive, though the exact cause is yet to be established.

Multiple police teams have been formed to trace the accused. While no arrests have been confirmed so far, officials say they have obtained crucial leads.

The body has been sent to KIMS Hospital in Hubballi for post-mortem. Security has been tightened in the area to prevent any law and order situation.

In a tragic detail, Fairoz was scheduled to get married on April 24, just two weeks after the incident.

#Dharwad #Karnataka #BreakingNews #MurderCase #YouthCongress

articles.title: ‘Midnight Mystery’ in Chamarajanagar Solved: Man Arrested for Stealing Women’s Undergarments
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The mystery behind a series of unusual thefts that had alarmed residents in Chamarajanagar has been solved, with police arresting a suspect involved in targeting women’s undergarments.

body.html:
The mystery behind a series of unusual thefts that had alarmed residents in Chamarajanagar has been solved, with police arresting a suspect involved in targeting women’s undergarments.

The accused, identified as Amruth, was apprehended by town police following complaints from multiple localities, including Indira Nagar, Housing Board Colony, and Karinjanapura.

Residents had reported that clothes left out to dry were being disturbed, but only women’s undergarments were going missing. Initially dismissed as items blown away by wind, the repeated pattern raised suspicion and led to police complaints.

During the investigation, police analysed CCTV footage, which showed a person moving suspiciously between 1 am and 3 am. The individual was seen entering residential lanes dressed in women’s clothing, with his face covered.

Based on these inputs, police launched a targeted operation and arrested the accused.

According to officials, Amruth would wait until residents were asleep, scale compound walls, steal undergarments, and flee. He allegedly used disguise to avoid identification while roaming deserted streets at night.

Police suspect possible mental health concerns due to the unusual nature of the acts and have initiated a medical and psychological evaluation of the accused.

During preliminary interrogation, he reportedly confessed to the thefts. Investigators are now probing his motive and what he did with the stolen items, as the crimes do not appear to be financially driven.

With the arrest, residents have expressed relief, as the incidents had created fear and confusion, with some even attributing the acts to supernatural causes.

#Chamarajanagar #Karnataka #BreakingNews #TheftCase #ViralNews

articles.title: Shocking Video from Rewa School: Principal Makes Student Fan Her, Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversial video from a government school in Rewa has sparked outrage after it showed a principal allegedly making a student fan her during school hours. The incident took place at Government Middle School Panasi in Teonthar area.

body.html:
A controversial video from a government school in Rewa has sparked outrage after it showed a principal allegedly making a student fan her during school hours.

The incident took place at Government Middle School Panasi in Teonthar area. In the viral clip, Principal Varsha Manjhi is seen sitting on a chair with earphones on, while a Class 6 student stands beside her, continuously fanning her.

The video, which surfaced a day after the incident, also shows the student appearing uncomfortable and repeatedly adjusting his hand due to fatigue.

Following the controversy, Collector Pratibha Pal reprimanded District Education Officer Ramraj Mishra and ordered an inquiry into the matter.

Officials confirmed that a three-member committee has been constituted to visit the school, interact with students, and submit a report. Further action will be taken based on the findings.

Attempts to contact the accused principal for her response were unsuccessful as her phone remained switched off.

The student’s family, belonging to an underprivileged background, stated that they did not lodge a complaint out of fear for the child’s future, but admitted that such behaviour in schools is inappropriate.

Meanwhile, the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) has demanded strict action, alleging that such incidents reflect growing misuse of authority in schools.

The incident has once again raised serious concerns over student welfare and discipline within government educational institutions.

#Rewa #MadhyaPradesh #ViralVideo #SchoolControversy #StudentRights

articles.title: Husband Kills Wife, Burns Face to Hide Identity: Shocking Murder Plot Uncovered in Akola
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a chilling case from Akola, police have arrested three accused, including the husband, in the brutal murder of a woman whose half-burnt body was found near the Annapurna Mata Temple.

body.html:
In a chilling case from Akola, police have arrested three accused, including the husband, in the brutal murder of a woman whose half-burnt body was found near the Annapurna Mata Temple.

The deceased has been identified as Ravina Pawar, who had delivered a baby just days before the incident. Her husband, Sadiq Shah Tashreef Shah, along with his mother Nurabi Shah and brother-in-law Irfan Shah, have been taken into custody.

The case came to light on Monday after police recovered a partially burnt body within the jurisdiction of Dabki Road police station. The victim’s face was severely charred, making identification difficult initially. Her identity was later confirmed through police outreach and investigation.

During the probe, the husband appeared before police and confessed to the crime. According to investigators, the couple, who had a love marriage, were frequently involved in disputes. On the night of the incident, an argument allegedly escalated, following which Sadiq strangled Ravina to death.

Police said the accused, along with family members, then hatched a plan to dispose of the body and destroy evidence. The body was dumped near the temple, and petrol was allegedly poured on the face before setting it on fire to prevent identification.

CCTV footage and technical evidence helped police trace the accused, who had taken shelter at a relative’s house.

Sudarshan Patil stated that the accused have been remanded to police custody till April 13, and the investigation is ongoing to establish the full motive.

In a tragic development, the victim’s newborn infant, just a few days old, is currently under medical care. Authorities have initiated steps through the Child Welfare Committee to ensure the child’s protection and care.

#Akola #Maharashtra #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: FASTag Row Turns Violent: Man Allegedly Beaten by Toll Staff on Bengaluru–Mysuru Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has been reported from Mandya district, where a young man was allegedly assaulted by toll plaza staff following a dispute over FASTag balance.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has been reported from Mandya district, where a young man was allegedly assaulted by toll plaza staff following a dispute over FASTag balance.

The victim, identified as Mahesh, was reportedly attacked at the Gananguru Toll Plaza two days ago while travelling with friends.

According to sources, the incident began when toll officials found insufficient balance in the FASTag account linked to his vehicle. Mahesh reportedly requested time to arrange the payment and attempted to reverse his vehicle while contacting friends for assistance.

However, the situation escalated after toll staff allegedly began verbally abusing him. Eyewitnesses claimed that the employees then seized his mobile phone and physically assaulted him.

Mahesh was reportedly chased, manhandled, and beaten by the staff, with witnesses alleging “goonda-like” behaviour at the toll plaza.

A video of the incident, captured on a mobile phone, has since surfaced online and is going viral, triggering strong public outrage.

Authorities have taken cognisance of the matter and stated that an investigation is underway. Commuters have demanded strict action, emphasising that violence over a payment dispute is unacceptable and raises serious concerns over safety on highways.

articles.title: Vrindavan Boat Tragedy EXPOSED: Viral Videos Show No Life Jackets, Overloading Before Deadly Capsize
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two shocking videos have surfaced from the tragic boat accident in Vrindavan, shedding light on the moments before and after the disaster that claimed multiple lives.

body.html:
Two shocking videos have surfaced from the tragic boat accident in Vrindavan, shedding light on the moments before and after the disaster that claimed multiple lives.

The first video, recorded barely 15 minutes before the हादसा, shows devotees joyfully chanting “Radhe-Radhe” while onboard. The clip, shared in a WhatsApp group named “Banke Bihari Member,” reveals a heavily crowded boat, mostly carrying women, with no life jackets in sight.

The second video captures the horrifying aftermath after the boat capsized in the Yamuna River. Devotees can be seen struggling in the water, crying for help, while nearby boatmen and locals rushed to carry out rescue operations.

According to officials, at least 10 tourists — including 7 women and 3 men — lost their lives in the incident. Around 11 people sustained injuries and are undergoing treatment, while 5 persons are still missing. All the victims had come from Punjab for a religious visit.

Eyewitnesses and survivors alleged negligence on part of the boatman. One survivor stated that the boat was being driven at high speed despite repeated warnings. “We told him two to three times to slow down, but he didn’t listen,” he said.

The accident reportedly occurred around 2:45 pm when strong winds caused the boat to lose balance and collide with a pontoon bridge located करीब 400 metres from KC Ghat. The impact led to the boat overturning instantly, throwing all passengers into the river.

Rescue operations were carried out by local divers, with teams from the administration, police, NDRF, and Army later joining the effort.

Preliminary findings and local accounts suggest that overloading was a major cause of the tragedy. Locals alleged that boats routinely carry far more passengers than permitted, often without any safety measures.

Residents and public representatives have also raised concerns over untrained operators, lack of regulation, and absence of life jackets. Demands are now growing for strict enforcement of safety norms, including passenger limits, mandatory life jackets, and proper licensing of boatmen.

Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, and further action is expected.
